title: Soft!
text:
Soft!. Update: After just a couple of days, I found a hole in my blanket. I've included a picture. I'm very disappointed. I don't know if it was there from the beginning or if it's new. Either way I would expect it to be a better quality.

Original Review: (4 stars) I live in Georgia and our winters are pretty mild. I tried having a nice down comforter on my bed this winter, but it was too warm for my husband and me. Up until this arrived, we were using a thin fleece blanket on our bed. This is a little thicker than the fleece blanket, but not much. When I first put it on the bed, it seemed too small. I put the corner with the instruction tag in the same position that I put all blankets, comforters, bedspreads - at the lower right (if you're standing at the foot of the bed facing the headboard). All of our blankets have the paper tag in that position. It barely covered the sides of the bed. I turned it sideways and it fit much better and hangs over the sides appropriately. The blanket is light weight. It's very soft. I like the simple plaid design. It washes well, too.
